page.overview:
What is Ralts?

Ralts is a small, humanoid Pokémon with a white body that has wide legs, teardrop arms and long green bangs that have two red horns. At a certain angle, Ralts's red (sometimes purple) eyes are visible.

Ralts is an empathic Pokémon that uses its two horns to sense a person's emotions. Negative emotions drive them away, while light and happy emotions make them a bit braver. If its trainer or nearby Pokémon are ecstatic, a Ralts will feel warmer.

Ralts evolves into Kirlia starting at level 20 and then evolves into either Gardevoir starting at level 30 or Gallade if it is male and touches a Dawn Stone.

Ralts debuted in Do I Hear a Ralts?. Max found it while it was very sick and decided to prove his abilities by taking responsibility for it. With the help of Ash's Snorunt, he rushed it to the nearest Pokémon Center. He later promised to return for Ralts when he became eligible to be a trainer.
